nom: Ursa Major Green Slate Mineral Polish

avis.texte: This has seriously changed my skin. I've only used it a few times but incorporating it into my evening routine every few days has made my skin feel significantly smoother. My favorite Ursa Major product so far.

I use this 2/3 times weekly and it gives me a fresh restart when the grime of life builds up. The smell is uplifting. I live in the southwest where it's hot, dusty and dry all summer. It's particularly uplifting in the warm months but I love it all year round. It is a gorgeous exfoliator.
I was surprised how moisturizing this scrub is! Super happy with it!
Feels wonderful, smells wonderful and who doesn't love a product that's good for your skin!
I tried this mineral face scrub/polish and it left my skin feeling really soft and refreshed….
This is a unique and impressive scrub - I love the size of the grit - it is small and not too abrasive but cleans like a champ - so glad I gave it a try!
Excellent product. Leaves my skin soft and supple….ready for UM face tonic, Forest Alchemy eye cream & the amazing luxury Golden Hour Recovery Cream.
This wonderful scrub does a great job of smoothing, and it leaves my skin so soft and bright. The lovely fragrance is amazing. Another Ursa Major hit!
Started using this product while I was pregnant since its one of the only exfoliants I could use. Continued using it afterwards because its just such a great product!
I love the way it makes my skin look and feel. My skin is more even tones and radiant since using this product.

avis.titre: Love it, but jar was only half full
avis.texte: I really love this gentle exfoliator, and I understand some settling, but it was only about half full of product. I did take pics and even shared with them, but never heard back, and will unfortunately not order again not knowing of it we be corrected.
I love this product! My skin feels so smooth after using it and it smells great. My favorite exfoliator I've ever tried.

I only love and want to use chemical free and clean, natural products on my skin. I am looking forward to getting great results from this polish. So glad I found Ursa Major and this cleanser. I am fighting rosacea also and hoping this helps too.

avis.titre: Been looking for this a while
avis.texte: I have sensitive skin, and the acids recommended by estheticians tend to be more irritating than helpful. This stuff is the bomb. The texture is superfine, so you could really over-do using it. But with a tiny amount and gentle motions, my skin is letting go of long-clogged pores without peeling, redness or irritation. Every third day seems to be the rhythm for me, and because a little goes a very long way, this will last me a while.
This gentle exfoliating wash has been amazing, it has helped smooth my sensitive skin and also reduce blackheads.

I love all of my Ursa Major products, but this one may be my favorite. My skin loves a good polishing a couple times a week. Every time I open it, I stick my nose in the jar and take a deep inhale for a boost of aromatherapy as well. Now, my most recent order featured the new packaging, and I know inflation and tariffs are hitting everybody, but it seems to me the scent is not as potent as it used to be. Still a great product though.

avis.titre: Great product- but Hate the new packaging design!
avis.texte: I bought this at Healthy Living in the older version of the packaging. I loved it! It works really well and I love the way it smells, fresh and clean, like a pine tree forest. You only need a little product. A little goes a long way. Be gentle and add small amounts of water if needed. It can be slightly dry going on. What's not to love? Then I went back to look at more of the Ursa Major products. I went to the Ursa Major stand and thought they had stopped selling the product altogether. I had to look for a bit and realized that all of the Ursa major products had brand new design packaging. I'm sorry, but I don't care for it. I still have my old box for the Green Slate Mineral Polish so when it's empty, I'm just going to keep that and reuse that box. I don't like the new box. I don't like the new jar, the way things look are important to me and they do make a difference. Skin care companies are doing this constantly, changing their packaging and I don't like this. They ruin a good thing. The old design was beautiful and I could ACTUALLY read the words clearly in nice clear white letters that stood out. The colors were bright and beautiful and the bright blue foreground looked lovely against the bright green mountains in the background! This is Vermont and it looked like the Green Mountains in VT! I just simply can't read the letters well on your new products and the Green Mountain scenery is gone! So sad. It all looks the same except the bold colors but some of those don't fit

Not only are the products good, but the customer service is outstanding. I recently placed a large order two days before a promo came out for free face wipes. I emailed UM and they honored the promo for me and shipped the wipes for free. They didn't have to do that, but it's those small simple things that make the difference in customer loyalty.

I love using this product. It smells good, it feels good and I think it's working on some of my clogged pores and tiny blackheads that have recently been appearing on my nose and cheeks (and I'm old!)

I have very sensitive skin and this stuff is amazing. I use it every other day. Typically I wash my face with oil only. On the days when I use the Green Slate Polish I use it over the oil I wash with. This works wonderfully in this way.

I received a sample of this in the mail and fell in love. In the past, I've used other polishes and they're good, but this one is the best. I'm a dryer skin and I love it, but it would have been good when my skin was oily too. I highly recommend it.
Just started using and it seems very nice. Not drying or harsh. Skin feels smooth and soft after use.

I received a sample in one of my orders and was really wowed! My skin felt amazing after and my face had such a soft glow. I immediately ordered and I look forward to trying more from this beautiful skin care URSA.

I have other products from Ursa Major and love them! I use the Golden Hour Recovery Cream and the Fantastic Face Wash daily. I love them both! I have a been a customer for a couple of years. I wanted to try something different and ordered the Green Slate Mineral Polish. I wasn't sure at first what to expect. I gently applied it and really liked it! My face feels super clean and has a glow about it after using it. A couple of times a week is all I need to bring my face back a youthful glow. It has a subtle smell which is just lovely. I am also happy your products come in glass! Finally a company paying attention to all the unnecessary plastic we do not need.

I love Ursa Major products. I've eaten a very clean diet and exercised regularly for 26 years. But always used a traditional professional level skin care regimen that I know was packed with chemicals. This is the first clean and EFFECTIVE skincare product I've found. Love it!

I'm new to Ursa Major but love everything I've tried so far. The green slate mineral polish is perfect for smoothing out my skin, removing dead skin off the top without use of chemicals or anything harsh. I'm using it three times a week. Highly recommend!!

avis.titre: Does it exactly what it promises
avis.texte: This product delivers 100% as advertised and did not bother my very, very sensitive skin one bit. Ursa Major has become my go-to for everything because their products have always worked wonders without irritating my skin!
This does a great job in removing dead skin to improve the texture and glow of my face and it is gemtle and non-irritating. .

Dear Ursa Major: I live in the Deep South in the USA. I am extremely allergic to poison oak, ivy, and sumac. I am also a gardener. I also seem to be a poison oak magnet and get severe rashes from those plants. This year, I tried the usual soaps, creams, calamine lotion, etc., etc. For Christmas this year , I received a gift of your Green Slate Mineral Polish. When the thick poison oak rash broke out this year, I decided to give it a go. Nothing to lose. Within an hour, the swelling and weeping was markedly decreased. And the itch subsided also. After a few uses, it's starting to dry out! Yay! I'll keep using this stuff to treat these poisonous plant rashes. It really soothes the skin. Thank you!
Leaves my skin very soft, I have sensitive skin and it doesn't irritate it.
The Green Slate Mineral Polish is wonderful! I use it 2 or 3 times per week and my skin is smoother than ever! It is the best that I have ever used! Thank you Ursa Major!!
I use twice a week and love that it doesn't leave skin red or irritated, just smooth and clean.
I love how my skin feels after washing with this scrub, especially after sweating and doing some dirty gardening
I love what this does for my skin.I use it everyday.I use it on my neck also

I've tried a lot of exfoliators over the years and this one beats all. You can feel it working...gritty WITHOUT irritation or redness. It rinses so easily and leaves ZERO residue...and ZERO dryness or tightness. My face is soft and healthy looking after. Absolutely no complaints, I'm a lifer with this stuff. Maybe a body wash like Green Slate in the future?! Thank you for nailing it, Ursa Major!

Love this exfoliating polish. I use it every other day and it leaves my skin vibrant and clear. I love the way my face feels moisturized after using in the shower. This is the first mineral exfoliator I have ever used that didn't clog my pores. I love the scent, it make me feel like I just had a facial.
I love the smell and texture of this product . My skin feels so fresh and rejuvenated after I use it .
I look forward to this at the end of the day to scrub off the day! I use several times a week. Love it!
The green slate mineral mask/scrub is winner. It's perfect tightening action is just right for a quick break or a more leisurely routine. Thanks for the great smell too!
In my mid-40s, I've never felt my skin this refreshed and invigorated—this scrub is a game-changer.
This product is wonderful! Great scent, so refreshing! Works wonders on my skin! Gentle but works great to exfoliate skin!
The light earthy fragrance is wonderful. I use this polish sparingly because my skin is dry, but this polishes up the skin beautifully !
Exactly what I was hoping it would be - I feel like I don't need makeup when I use it!
Lovely sudsy finely grained polishing cleanser; very much enjoy using it.
This is a cooling and refreshing masque to wear for however long you wish. It leaves my skin feeling more awake and alive, more clarified. I mainly like how it makes me feel more refreshed.
I am noticing differences in my face since using the Green Slate Mineral Polish. It has smoothed out some of the fine lines and added luster to my face.
I am using this product twice a week now and I see a noticeable difference. My skin is glowing, and I don't feel like it is damaging. It also smells divine.
Wonderful ! It's a lovely emollient, 100 natural. Love your products!!

Mineral polish is well named. It leaves my skin feeling clean and polished but not dry unlike other exfoliates, I have used. It is gentle but does the job well. It has a wonderful smell as a bonus. My face gets exposed to lots of dust and sweat because of my life style. In the past I would have break outs. Since I've started using this polish my skin handles the elements so much better. It's thorough but gentle at the same time.

avis.titre: Goodbye dead flakes, HELLO GLOWING SKIN!
avis.texte: I've been using Ursa Major skin care for six months now and absolutely love it. But I using the Greenslate mineral polish for the first time and what a difference it makes to my regimen! I can see, and feel the difference in the absorption of the other products after the exfoliation! It is gentle, yet effective! Big fan over here!!

avis.titre: The best exfoliate I have ever used
avis.texte: Another amazing product. The intense scrub is amazing and buffs my skin without irritation. My skin feels smooth, fresh, and hydrated after use. I stick to 1-2 a week ans follow with a Serum.
I've used so many exfoliators that really irritate my skin. Green Slate has a wonderful scent and does not irritate at all. My skin feels clean and fresh after using it.
Amazing feeling of clean and hydration, skin feels smooth and not over stripped.

This was one of the first Ursa Major products I tried. I learned about the brand through social media, but since starting to use it, I have discovered that a good friend also uses it. I use this product only about three times each week, but I look forward to those days—the amazing scent, the clean feel—it's all SO good.

I received this produce as a sample, when I ordered the Golden Hour Cream. I loved it so much I ordered it, and it's my absolute favorite. My skin feels so smooth and clean, sloughing off the winter dry patches/
It is an amazing product. Smells great and my skin looked renewed!
I had to buy two more jars so I have one for the shower and one for when I take a bath.

I was sent a sample of this with an order. I love the scent, it's "woodsy". (I wish the hand cream had this scent.) I don't need this product so I didn't notice any difference in the feel or appearance of my skin but I might buy it anyway as a special treat for my senses on occasion.

I love how tiny the exfoliating particles are in this polish. It's not too abrasive, and leaves the skin feeling not only refreshed, but also nourished. Somehow it's still creamy and doesn't leave my skin parched. I'm so pleased that I decided to try it! Thank you!
Refresh your face with the polish. Feels wonderful and brightens up your skin!

avis.titre: Fresh scent, fine scrub, love it!
avis.texte: I've done a bit of herbal medicine making, and your products all are palpably formulated and made by humans out of actual herbal ingredients. I love this polish, use it a few times a week. Thanks for another fine product!
I love this polish. It smells amazing and is gentle on my skin.

This is wonderful. I have been using 2-3 times a week for just a couple of weeks. Definitely can feel the difference. Noteworthy of how bright and smooth my face feels. I love the smell, it is not harsh and it is gentle on my skin !!

avis.titre: I LOVE EVERYTHING FROM URSA MAJOR!
avis.texte: I have very very sensitive/combination skin and with these products, I can soothe and satiate my stubborn and difficult skin issues. THANK YOU

avis.titre: I'm in love with this polish!
avis.texte: This has done more for my skin than any other product I've ever used. Mixed with the milk cleanser and then other products my face looks years younger.
I could not be more enthusiastic about this product. It is gentle and just right for my sensitive skin. The scent is amazing! Please make more products with this scent!

I just tried this mineral polish for the first time. Even though I have sensitive skin, this polish did not irritate my skin! In fact, my skin was so smooth and refreshed afterwards. Loved the results of the polish and the smell is so light and fresh.
I do like the idea behind the polish and exfoliating the skin. I have only used it once so will see in a couple months.

avis.titre: Really feel like I am polished after using...
avis.texte: I bought this for my husband and I as a christmas present, and we've only just started using it every other day (today marking the 3rd time we will use it). After my first use I really felt like I had been polished and my skin reflected that...and he looked polished (and glowing) too! I expect this will be a repeat purchase for me into the future. And maybe even a gift for others!
My skin needs exfoliating 2-3x a week and this very gentle face polish is perfectly gentle, revealing smooth soft skin.

avis.titre: A little harsh for very sensitive skin
avis.texte: I wanted to love this product because I could use a good exfoliate in my skincare routine. This one was just too harsh for my dry and sensitive skin, and it caused quite a reaction. I use the total line of Ursa Major for cleansing and moisturizing and couldn't be more pleased with the results. I'm sorry this one didn't work for me.

I live and work in Antarctica for 6 months out of the year. It's an incredibly dry, cold, windy environment with lots of sun in the summer, so it's super challenging to take care of my skin. Not only that, but our waste water facility is very limited, so exfoliants are discouraged. However, they are set up to manage volcanic ash because it is already everywhere down here! This product, along with several others from Ursa Major, keeps my skin happy and healthy on this harsh continent, and I can be mindful about my community impact.
My skin looks amazing after using this product three times a week. Gentle yet cleansing to provide my skin with a clean and glowing feel
Love this product!! Smells wonderful! My skin feels amazing after using it

avis.titre: Skin looks and feels polished and brighter
avis.texte: Love this scrub and I use it sometimes every day! Love the feel and the smell and the nice glow I have after using it! Get it!
Goes on easy and not super gritty like others I've tried. Just enough to do the job. Smells clean and my face feels like silk when I take it off, Great product!
The scrubbing grains are very fine, setting my skin up to properly absorb my moisturizer

After trying this new product for a few weeks now it's really lovely! It truly feels like a polish and has a light earthy fragrance that is soothing. For my skin which is more oily/ combination, this polish is doing the job and leaving it feeling refreshed, not irritated. A mini spa treatment in a jar- highly recommend!
Absolutely love it! Not to abrasive but makes my skin feel refreshed and ready for my mountain glow golden serum before bed. LOVE Ursa Major products !

avis.titre: Love the product, not the packaging
avis.texte: I love the texture of this product and my skin looks great every time I use it. I sometimes leave it on a little longer to absorb all the mineral-y goodness. However, getting this product open and using it in the shower is a pain. It's hard to open the plastic cover with wet fingers and tricky not getting water in once its open. Tata Harper has a scrub of similar consistency that they package in a pump bottle and that works fine. I hope Ursa Major will consider other packaging in the future! It's a great product overall.
This new product is especially helpful after having worn sunscreen and cleansing my face. I know that my skin is truly clean and my face looks and feels healthy. Thank you for such a great product.

whoa! THIS is the PRODUCT! the one I've been looking for..this mineral polish is an absolute game changer for my skin, feel like a fresh start EVERY time I use it ~ used alone or sometimes I even add a tiny amount to my Ursa Major face wash & have really loved the results & feel of both of them together. THANK YOU! xo

I was curious to see how I would like this as I love, love love the other products. It made my skin feel like it was really clean and fresh. It is a delightful 2x/week routine I look forward to. I highly recommend it as part of your skin care regimen.

I love how fine this exfoliating polish is. I feel like a lot of others I've tried are coarser, and this feels much gentler on my skin. I also appreciate that it doesn't feel like I've stripped the moisture from my skin either. I recommend!
This product has a lovely light fragrance, is invigorating, and leaves your skin soft and stimulated.
I do enjoy this scrub. I like to wet my skin prior to using. It feels a little more gentle on the skin. Your skin does feel really soft and hydrated after rinsing which I love.

avis.titre: All I can say "W O W"
avis.texte: I purchased this mask and had the jar in my skincare bathroom shelf and just now I am starting to use it. This incredible mask really shows that it's a labor of love. It is super fine, and slides on the skin evenly and gloriously. It works gentle enough not to upset sensitive skin. One use and I am enchanted by the results. I wish you could work on a shower gel and body moisturizer with the same scent. Oh My... It is hard to point out what scent it is, but if I close my eyes, the fragrance reminds me of walks thru a pine forest after the rain. It is intoxicatingly pure and immediately works on relaxing my senses. I can't get enough of it.

My middle aged skin was breaking out even with using retin a. Since starting the mineral polish and other ursa products, I have stopped retin a and my skin is clearer than it's been in a very long time. I'm so happy I found your products! Thank you!
Good balance as this product isn't overly harsh, but still provides a good scrub. My skin has never felt this even/smooth! The fragrance is pleasant and refreshing. Great product!

Just received this and I love it--the exfoliant texture is super fine and the clay feels so good. I even like the scent--sort of like earthy eucalyptus. It's a huge pot too. I can tell I will be using and loving this for some time to come.

I tried this on a whim during a big sale time. I'm glad I did. The texture and smell is amazing. It has a moisturizing quality that makes it stand out above other exfoliating products. My skin feels renewed after each use. This is another new staple in my UM collection. Love all their products.

avis.titre: Feels like I had a facial!
avis.texte: I LOVE THIS PRODUCT as I do with all Ursa Major products! Each time I use it I feel as if I had a facial! I have thrown away all other skin care products. I love your brand - thank you! You have changed my skin!
I have sensitive skin so have to be careful with exfoliating. This is a very fine scrub with a lovely scent. I use it every other day. Make face feel extra smooth.
Work great I use on face neck and chest and follow the other 2 steps
The product is great. You can tell the quality instantly and it feels like such a treat to use. Highly recommended to anyone who is considering it.
I have older, sensitive skin. I have used the product four times. The ingredients are a nice blend of exfoliants. I am not fond of the gritty texture.
This polish did a wonderful job of clearing away dead skin cells. I felt like a new woman the first time I used it. Did not irritate my skin.
So pleased with the effectiveness of this mineral polish. Just using it twice a week smoothes and brightens my skin. Thanks!

I keep imagining I still have combo young skin with acne. But I am 55 and no longer have that skin. That being said, this is a little drying for me. If I were younger, it would be my go to weekly. I think I can use this bi-weekly for some deep cleaning. It is awesome stuff though.
I've tried so many exfoliating products for decades. I finally found something that actually does what I want in one product. So happy with the results .Give it a try!

avis.titre: Just wonderful!  Leaves me skin looking and feeling great!
avis.texte: This is just the right amount of exfoliation - very fine but concentrated, so it really works. Highly recommend.
I've only been using once a week! It does what it claims, exfoliates well! My skin feels so fresh and smooth after a use and stays that way for days!

Jury is still out..... only using this 2x / week.... it is a very rough fine granular polish.... using it gingerly as not sure if it will irritate my skin. I normally use nothing with a scent or at least something very light. So if it will help with roughing up all those dead skin cells and grime that gets on your face.... it will be great! Just haven't used it long enough to see results on my wrinkles or fine lines.
